meta.name: add-onecli
meta.description: Install or refresh OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider. Use when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, setup, and agent guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把命令行网关提供方装好并刷新,让运行环境和审批链路重新接通
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在给 agent 配置网关,或旧装需要迁移到新的网关接口
copy.tagline_en: Install or refresh the CLI gateway provider to reconnect the runtime and approvals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're wiring a gateway for your agent or migrating an older install

howto.what: 它把 OneCLI 装成 NanoClaw 的 gateway provider:把适配器、测试与说明文件复制到对应路径,注册该 provider,安装固定版本 SDK,运行 setup 配置网关,再构建并跑测试验证。
howto.when: 当 setup 选择 OneCLI、已有 OneCLI 安装要迁移到 gateway seam,或需从 in-tree 包恢复其运行时与审批桥接时触发。

say.text: 用 add-onecli 把 OneCLI 装成网关 provider
say.note: 复制文件、注册 provider 并安装固定版本 SDK

say.text: 运行 add-onecli 的 setup 脚本配置网关
say.note: 健康的现有安装会被复用

say.text: 跑一下 OneCLI 相关测试确认安装完成
say.note: 先构建,再跑指定 vitest 测试

howto.what_en: It installs OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider: copies the adapter, tests, and guidance into place, registers the provider, installs the pinned SDK, runs the setup script, then builds and runs tests to validate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime and approval bridge must be restored from the in-tree package.

say_en.text: Install OneCLI as my gateway provider with add-onecli
say_en.note: Copies files, registers the provider, adds the pinned SDK

say_en.text: Run add-onecli's setup script to configure the gateway
say_en.note: A healthy existing install is reused

say_en.text: Run the OneCLI tests to confirm the install
say_en.note: Builds first, then runs the listed vitest tests
